source: 1× #5 (block 24,927,663); 3.5× PRISTINE scan (block 24,358,000); 5× #29 (block 24,546,596). Exact value-node counts per level.

storageDepth.metric: storage-trie leaf count by depth level (aggregate over all contracts)
storageDepth.source: 1× nm StateComposition mainnet distribution; 3.5× PRISTINE scan; 5× #29. Value-node counts per level.
storageDepth.note: The opposite of account depth: mainnet storage tries are shallow (most leaves at depths 5–7, since most contracts hold 1–3 slots), but 3.5× and 5× pile up at depth 9 — the storage-spam mega-tries. The per-contract histogram's open "16k+" bucket hides this; the depth distribution exposes it. 7× and 10× pending.
